title: Wasted Florida Man’s Walgreens Visit Earns Him Multiple Felonies
description:
A Florida man was arrested after an alleged drunken incident at a Walgreens in Palm Beach County.  Police took Eduardo Ortiz into custody after witnesses said he tried to pick up a prescription medication while intoxicated. Witnesses said that after Ortiz was refused service he swiped a 4-pack of beers from a refrigerator before heading out of the store without paying. Officers found Eduardo sitting in front of the store before the situation escalated earning Ortiz multiple charges and a trip to jail. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
